agency: India Meteorological Department (IMD) - Regional Meteorological Centre, Guwahati
synoptic_situation: Upper air cyclonic circulation over East Assam & Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, actively feeding moisture across Brahmaputra and Subansiri drainage corridors.

forecast_periods.rainfall_category: Very Heavy to Extremely Heavy Rainfall
forecast_periods.impact: Severe waterlogging in low-lying revenue circles; localized flash flooding across Gai & Jiadhal river alluvial fans.
Sustained high runoff; prolonged drainage congestion in Silapathar and Sissiborgaon.
Intermittent thundershowers; river water levels remain close to warning thresholds.
Receding precipitation trends; residual embankment monitoring required.
